title: how to make a $1 million dollar ad for your brand
description: a hands-on workshop on making films with ai — no camera, no crew, no studio. taught by sameer z, architect turned ai professional.
body:
film used to mean cameras, crews, studios, and budgets. not anymore. sameer z — architect turned ai professional — shows you how to direct, shoot, and edit films using ai tools, end to end, on a single laptop.

this is a hands-on workshop. you will walk out having written, storyboarded, generated, and edited your own short film — with tools that are accessible today, no cinema degree required.

schedule.title: check-in
schedule.description: arrive, grab a seat, meet the other builders.

schedule.title: the new film set
schedule.description: why the camera is optional now — an overview of the ai film stack.

schedule.title: writing the film
schedule.description: script, storyboard, and shot list with ai — from idea to plan in minutes.

schedule.title: generating the footage
schedule.description: text-to-video, image-to-video, and consistency tricks that make ai footage feel directed.

schedule.title: editing and sound
schedule.description: cut the film, add voiceover, music, and sound design without a studio.

schedule.title: screening
schedule.description: watch your short film on the big screen and get feedback from the room.

includes: hands-on build: your own ai-generated short film
curated prompt library for film, story, and visuals
a working ai film stack you can keep using
ai builders network access — private builder community
outcomes: a finished short film made entirely with ai
a repeatable process for ai filmmaking
confidence picking the right tools for each stage
whoFor: founders and marketers who need video without a crew
architects, designers, and creators moving into ai
anyone who has ever wanted to make a film but thought they couldn't
